irregularities.finding: GEMSDOE25 flagged that band 6 'tc' of the official stack (described as magnetic tilt/total-curvature) actually equals the radiometric total-count channel. Re-verified here on read: values are positive (3.7-70.6 range) consistent with radiometric TC, not a magnetic derivative; our RAW_BANDS renames it 'tc_radiometric'.
irregularities.action: Kept as a radiometric band; no magnetic-edge claims derive from it. Report to organizers if a data erratum channel exists.

irregularities.finding: The acquisition-line audit (knowledge/01 §2d) predicted E-W striking edges (flight-line aliasing, 200/400 m E-W lines) should be *less* persistent under continuation. Measured on the full grid: mean magnetic persistence by strike is E-W 0.656, Other 0.607, N-S 0.562 — E-W edges are, on average, the MOST persistent. The naive 'E-W = artifact' heuristic is therefore NOT usable as a filter on this grid; regional geology (E-W striking ranges in the Walker Lane transform corridor) plausibly dominates the aliasing signal.
irregularities.action: Line-suppression (H29-4 notch) remains registered as a future experiment; the persistence filter itself does not encode strike assumptions. See evidence/worming_receipt.json.

irregularities.finding: Only 2.7% of the live-scored dotted (0.2600) emission dots coincide with p95 level-0 potential-field edges; the parent detector's habitat is mostly terrain/thermal/structural, not geophysical edge maxima. A hard worming GATE therefore has almost no power over the parent emission; only re-ORDERING (or feature-level fusion) can express the hypothesis.
irregularities.action: Screened both ways (A1 gate, A2 rank, B1 head-features) per knowledge/01; report all three regardless of sign.
